PurposeEnergy describes the St. Albans facility as its project, reports 50,000 GPD, 1 MW, a 20-year 2019 Standard Offer, December 2024 commercial operations and Ben & Jerry's as anchor client
PurposeEnergy announced the May 29, 2025 grand opening, May 2023 construction start and December 2024 first electricity export
It calls SAINT the first PurposeEnergy project fully funded by Quinbrook after the platform acquisition and describes the 2021 Ben & Jerry's feedstock agreement

Boylan Crest describes St. Albans advisory work primarily as monetization of investment tax credits, not disclosed sponsor equity
